title: ¿Independencia para quién?
goal: Read who actually benefited from independence: citizenship was proclaimed equal for free men, but slavery mostly wasn't abolished, indigenous land protections were weakened, and no woman gained the vote.

items: Explain what 'free womb' laws actually did and didn't do.
Explain what happened to legal protection of indigenous communal lands.
State when women actually gained the vote in most of the region.
Contrast what independence meant for criollo elites versus most of the population.
Use passive voice, including its negative form, to synthesize unequal outcomes.
